notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You have a way to give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible.
description:
Give Sporeweb Weaver indestructible by any method.
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Halana triggers, causing you to pay {2} to have that creature deal damage equal to its power to Sporeweb Weaver.
Sporeweb Weaver triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and create a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Halana triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Halana trigger, causing you to pay {2} to deal 1 damage to Sporeweb Weaver.
Repeat from step 4.
